about: Modwerk source-only comp-preview package for Analog Rytm MKII OS 1.74, compiled from sdk/analog-rytm-mkii/modules/comp-preview.

mods.title: Compressor Preview
mods.summary: One more compressor page with a scrolling estimate of the master compressor's gain reduction, reached by pressing the compressor page key again.
mods.description: Compressor Preview adds a page behind the compressor page key on the FX track: a scrolling trace of the estimated gain reduction of the master compressor, so you can see what THR, ratio and attack do before you hear it. Pressing the key again returns to the stock page. FUNC + the page key switches the layout: level, threshold and gain reduction together, or gain reduction alone with 0 dB at the top; FUNC + LEFT/RIGHT sets the scroll speed and FUNC + UP/DOWN the vertical scale. The estimate is built from the voices, the PRE delay and reverb returns, the master distortion and each SEQ's sidechain, with a peak detector, a static curve that THR slides along and one attack/release pole. It is an estimate: the compressor has no gain-reduction readback. It is an elemod port of MrScruff's rytm-mods 0006-comp-preview with his code unchanged; the preview is listed in the compressor view through core-ar2's page lists (core_view_pages), so other modules' pages can sit beside it.
mods.author: Iced-Cream
mods.on_unit: On an Analog Rytm MKII on OS 1.74, as reported by the author: comp-preview 1.1 on core-ar2 0.4 with the other rytm2_mods ports (Q4A4, Q4D4, U4A4, U4D4, U4F4, U4M4, 2026-10-21) cycled COMP and the preview, its FUNC keys worked, it was kept on leaving the FX track, and the load guard paused the trace rather than the audio. This package's own bytes, and the Modwerk base, have not been flashed from the site.
